newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P affirms South Australia's AA local rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P affirms South Australia's AA local rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday that it affirmed the AA long-term and A1 short-term local currency ratings of the state of South Australia.
The ratings agency said the local currency outlook is stable.

"The rating reflects South Australia's continued progress in reducing the significant debt levels accumulated at the beginning of the decade, the ongoing strengthening of the budgetary position, and the lower potential for rapid growth in the state's economy than some of the other states," S&P said.
"The supporting relationship between the federal and state/territorial governments in Australia also underpins the rating," it said.

South Australia's stable ratings outlook was due to an expectation that the state's debt position would continue its gradual improvement and that growth in gross state product would continue to lag the national average by about 0.75 percentage points over the short-to-medium term, S&P said.
